# Media Literacy: Analyzing the 9/11 Conspiracy

## Introduction
The September 11 attacks remain one of the most studied cases in modern history, yet they remain a subject of intense debate. While the official investigation concluded that the attacks were the work of al-Qaeda, conspiracy theories persist in the public imagination. This article examines how these narratives function, examining the psychological mechanisms behind their spread and the rhetorical strategies used to sustain them.

## The Narrative Construction
The 9/11 conspiracy theory emerged primarily through three channels:

### 1. The "Flight 93" Narrative
The most persistent theory posits that Flight 93 was hijacked by terrorists. Proponents argue that the passengers were targeted for ideological reasons, not just mechanical failure.
